title: Berta language
description: Nilo-Saharan language spoken by the Berta in Sudan and Ethiopia
extract: Berta a.k.a. Gebeto, is a Berta language spoken by the Berta people in Sudan and Ethiopia. As of 2006 Berta had approximately 180,000 speakers in Sudan. The three Berta languages, Gebeto, Fadashi and Undu, are often considered dialects of a single language. Berta proper includes the dialects Bake, Dabuso, Gebeto, Mayu, and Shuru; the dialect name Gebeto may be extended to all of Berta proper.
